description: Create or update a customer organization (Subscribers > Organizations in the dashboard) by external ID. Attributes merge into the stored attributes (a null value deletes a key; set replaceAttributes to replace them all). Optional members are added in the same call. Use this to model companies, workspaces or teams so segments can filter on `organization.plan` and emails can use `{{organization.name}}` (`account.*` still works). The first organization turns Organizations on for the workspace; it fails with a 409 error when contacts already use a custom attribute named `account` or `account.*`, which must be renamed first.

attributes.description: Account attributes such as plan, seats, mrr or trialEndsAt (max 100 keys). Nested objects flatten to dotted names.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

externalId.description: Customer-owned account (organization/workspace) ID, e.g. the org id in your app.

members.description: Contacts to add as members in the same call.

email.description: Contact email. Creates the contact when adding a new one.

subscriberExternalId.description: Contact external ID, as an alternative to email.

replaceAttributes.description: Replace all stored attributes instead of merging.

name: upsert_account

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `upsert_account` MCP tool.
